verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no first-party documentation of an SSH integration that carries terminfo, shell integration, or config to remote hosts. Community items describe only user-side workarounds: setting TERM=xterm-256color in SSH config, manually distributing xterm-ghostty.terminfo with tic, or following a terminfo help page. Users also report SSH not working out of the box, and none of this earns credit for the product's own capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can SSH to remote hosts with the terminal's own integration carrying my terminfo, shell integration, and config along
